comment: Entry-trigger config for scripts/watchlist_monitor.py. Polyclaude horizon constraint per project memory 2026-05-08: bankroll locked to <1y holding horizon. Multi-year plays go to IBKR. Polyclaude-route requires: (a) <1y catalyst clock, (b) EVM-chain accessible (crypto on Uniswap V3 / wrapped tokens) — equities default to ibkr_surface regardless.
